title: Qibaadah astah dacrise
intro: diini aracih addat, barkatle rooci qibaadah hanaawih gubat qarseenih yenen. Tama num, Yallih waado sinni caylaa kee wale sumaq yakkuh, assakat le tekkookah addat lafale doori digiruh madqimteh sugte. Ken safar adda xer numma, gexkalit le mabla kee inkih tan seehadayti baxih baxsale asta xisaanam qaddoysa.
clues: Anu Yalli dooreh saytunnowteh yi waktih sayyok inkih.
Anu yi salat footimal assakat le rizqih xayyooweh yan gitah yan nabiyyih dacrisah gubat suge.
Anu inni buxah marak Yalla qibaadah cankah arac fan inni baxsimeh.
Malayka qigduk yan numih weelol yol tumbulleeh, anu lab num aaxige waa way, saytun baxi xaagu bahta.
Xalay biyaakak lakal, qusba rizqi gorrisuh caxâ caxak dab axaxisam yoh amrise.
Anu inni ummattah quukak uduure waqdi, oson yoo esseren, takkay immay yi baxi miraaciini gurral yi kalaluh qarkayto fanah yaabe.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
